nodes.label: Backend Roadmap Checklist
nodes.rationale: Status is verified from code, not assumed: every [x] is backed by a working endpoint or a passing test. 294 tests, 15 migrations, 49 entities, 15 services, 83 admin endpoints.

nodes.label: Permission Enum (43 permissions, 13 modules)
nodes.rationale: Permissions are never written into the token - they are read from the database on every request, so revoking one weakens the existing token immediately.

nodes.label: @RequirePermission / PermissionAspect / PermissionInterceptor
nodes.rationale: The interceptor runs before request-body validation (bug B16), and AdminEndpointGuardTest makes it impossible to add an unguarded admin endpoint.

nodes.label: OldCastingFrozenTest
nodes.rationale: Freezes the legacy casting paths, controllers, entities, table names and repositories so the working production flow cannot be renamed away.

nodes.label: ExistingCastingRegressionTest
nodes.rationale: The more important of the two guards: the route can stay in place while the internal logic breaks, so this test exercises the application, accept/reject and bot message behaviour itself.

nodes.label: /api/v1/app/** API Namespace
nodes.rationale: The legacy /api/v1/** namespace is frozen and the new platform is versioned beside it; /content/{id}/episodes deliberately returns no video link - that only comes from /watch/{episodeId} after the right is confirmed.

nodes.label: OTP Login (unwritten)
nodes.rationale: Spec R14 requires a 4-6 digit code, 5-minute life, 60s resend and a 15-minute block after 3 errors - none of it exists; app users still sign in through the legacy /api/v1/auth/login, which must keep working until clients migrate.

nodes.label: Missing Client-Facing APIs
nodes.rationale: catalog, content page, search, comments, ads, me, purchases and OTP auth are unopened, so the mobile app currently cannot reach the new content at all; a content card endpoint is missing, so a direct deep link finds an empty home cache.

nodes.label: Backend Next Steps by Impact
nodes.rationale: Ordered by impact: client APIs, payments (blocked on store billing risk), FCM, refresh token store, device limit, OpenAPI, and the Bunny Stream video hosting decision that contradicts the current local-storage plus Range solution.

nodes.label: Soft Delete Strategy
nodes.rationale: Two strategies by entity type, with deliberate hard-delete exceptions and a guard test; a disappearing row is not merely absent data but broken history.

nodes.label: 27 Unindexed Foreign Keys Found
nodes.rationale: Audit of database rules also found five translation tables whose unique constraint column order was reversed, which defeated the intended lookups.

nodes.label: N+1 Fix That Created Its Own N+1
nodes.rationale: The first correction introduced a new N+1 and, in the first review, lost data; documented as a warning against blind batching.

nodes.label: 2FA Deliberately Not Implemented
nodes.rationale: The channel (SMS, TOTP or email) has not been chosen by the client; the architecture is ready but writing it now would guess the channel, and the same blocker also holds up self-service password reset.
